---
title: Call for papers
---

## Email

**From:** the shared workshop Gmail account
**To:** `[workshop Google Group]`
**Bcc:** `masakhane-nlp@googlegroups.com`, `mlds-africa@googlegroups.com`
**Subject:** [First/Second] Call for Papers: [N]th AfricaNLP Workshop at [HOST YEAR]

```text
Greetings,

The [N]th AfricaNLP Workshop at [HOST YEAR] ([City, Country])
[First/Second] Call for Papers

Theme: [Theme]
Info: [website]
Submission: [OpenReview link, or "to be announced"]

The [N]th AfricaNLP Workshop will be co-located with [HOST YEAR] in [City, Country].
This year's theme is [Theme]. We invite submissions on natural language processing
for African languages, including [three or four topics that fit the theme].

Submission formats
- Papers: 4-8 pages (archival or non-archival)
- Extended abstracts: up to 2 pages (non-archival)
- ARR submissions: papers with completed reviews and a meta-review from [eligible ARR cycles]

Key dates (anywhere on Earth)
- Direct submission: [date]
- ARR commitment: [date]
- Notification: [date]
- Workshop: one day during [HOST YEAR] ([conference dates]); exact date to be announced

More details: [website]
Contact: [workshop Google Group]

Best,
[Name]
[Role], AfricaNLP [YEAR]
On behalf of the AfricaNLP [YEAR] Organizing Committee
```

## Targeted invitation (example: AIMS students)

```text
Dear [group],

We invite you to take part in the [N]th AfricaNLP Workshop, co-located with
[HOST YEAR] in [City, Country]. This year's theme is [Theme].

The workshop brings together researchers, practitioners and students working on
NLP for African languages. We welcome submissions on foundational research,
datasets and evaluation, multilingual technology and applied projects.

Submission guidelines and dates are on the workshop website: [website]
Questions: [workshop Google Group]

Best regards,
[Name]
[Role], AfricaNLP [YEAR]
```
